responsibility: Declares the semantic-item, congruence-class, and optimizer infrastructure for IPA identical code folding. It defines abstractions for function/variable semantic items, reference tracking, class hashing and refinement, merged-variable bookkeeping, removal hooks, and the sem_item_optimizer workflow that groups and merges equivalent symtab nodes. This header provides the pass’s core data structures above the GIMPLE comparator layer.
same_name_distinction: Declares the main IPA ICF abstractions—semantic items, usage/reference maps, congruence classes, hashing traits, and the sem_item_optimizer interface. Unlike gcc/ipa-icf.cc, it does not run the pass or perform merges; it defines the optimizer’s data model and API surface.
